name: Retired Holy Crusader (Human Paladin 8)
source: The War of the Goblin King
book: The War of the Goblin King

facets.bk: The War of the Goblin King

body:
Retired Holy Crusader
CR 7

XP 3,200
Male human paladin 8
LG Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 25, touch 9, flat-footed 25 (+12 armor, -1 Dex, +4 shield)
hp 64 (8d10+16)
Fort +8, Ref +4, Will +9
Defensive Abilities aura of courage, aura of resolve, divine grace, divine health; Immune charm spells and spell-like effects, disease, fear

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (20 ft. in armor)
Melee +1 longsword +10 (1d8+2/19-20)
Special Attacks channel positive energy (4d6, Will DC 17), smite evil (3/day)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 8th; concentration +11)

At will–detect evil

Paladin Spells Prepared (CL 5th; concentration +8)

2nd–bull’s strength (2)
1st–bless weapon, protection from evil

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 9, Con 11, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 16
Base Atk +8; CMB +9; CMD 18
Feats Combat Casting, Power Attack, Shield Focus, Toughness, Weapon Focus (Longsword)
Skills Diplomacy +14, Knowledge (religion) +12, Profession (soldier) +12, Sense Motive +12
Languages Common
SQ aura of good, divine weapon, lay on hands (3d6, 7/day), mercy (diseased, fatigued)
NPC Gear +1 longsword, +1 heavy steel shield, +1 warplate, cloak of resistance +1
